notes: Authored in this repository. There is no upstream pin and no custody table.

skills/plan/scripts/check_plan.py is the package's command surface. It answers --help and reads a plan file. It writes nothing and reads no credential variable, so credential_prefixes and mutating_operations are empty and named in declared_none.
The script lives inside skills/plan/ so a harness that installs the skill directory, rather than the whole package, still receives the checker.
